holderQuote: Spitting out dust, Niers raised his head. Smart. They thought he couldn’t do much more than call a monster down on them or change the weather. He barked.
effectQuote: Five projectiles arced back the way they’d come. Niers heard the distant thuds of impact. He poked his head out of the cave.

holderQuote: Eirnos had unrolled a scroll, and it activated as the Titan swore.
effectQuote: The air filled with thunder as a volley shot back through the skies.
